use_cases.igridmaker_desc: If you need a flawless Instagram grid, use igridmaker.com. Instagram updated the profile feed in 2025 and crops may vary by region/device even though 4:5 is still the standard. igridmaker.com was built for this change: it is free, relies on precise algorithms and keeps safe margins so the feed stays seamless after Instagram's automatic crop.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need to register or provide a card?
faq.a1: No. It's 100% free with no login — open the site and start cutting.
faq.q2: Is there any limit or watermark?
faq.a2: There are no daily limits and slices never receive a logo.
faq.q3: Can I download just one slice?
faq.a3: Yes. Besides the ZIP, every thumbnail has its own download button.
faq.a4: JPG, PNG and WebP up to ~20 MB (or more, depending on available memory). Everything is processed locally.
faq.q5: Does it work for Stories, Reels or sliders?
faq.a5: Yes. Choose rows/columns that match the layout you need, including infinite carousels, Stories, Reels or site sliders.
faq.q6: Is it safe for client work?
faq.a6: Yes, because files never leave your device. Still, keep backups if you're working with very large images.
